source.release_commit: The completed source commit is recorded in README_BUNDLE.md in the distribution bundle.

scope.primary_goal: Define intrinsic O-markings and full very strong Q-markings, their moduli and the forgetful morphism Q -> O with its fibers.
scope.O_marking: The adopted minimal definition includes the intrinsic Gabriel-Krull rank-one torsion-free condition, AZ ampleness, anticanonical Hilbert series and H(A)=A. Exceptionality, smooth properness and a numerical Picard lattice are not included as independent minimal axioms.
scope.Q_marking: Labelled ordered rooted cut quiver; full very strong collection beginning with a structure object; minimal homogeneous augmented presentation of the rolled-up End algebra. No arrow bases, relation bases, presentation isomorphism or potential is marked.
scope.hearts: The base abelian category is reconstructed as anticanonical qgr by its ample pair. The only other surface heart used for comparison is the AS heart.
scope.fibers: Distinguishes the homotopy fiber over a specified base object, the scalar-rigidified homotopy fiber, and the fiber of the map on isomorphism-class sets. Only the last is quotiented by base automorphisms.
scope.second_forgetting: Retained Lambda/ZK very-general theorem concerns the exceptional structure-object sublocus. It is not asserted for every minimal O-marking.
scope.relative_moduli: Defined on the etale site relative to a specified compatible enhanced-category/heart/flat-object/Serre/base-change model, followed by stackification. This is not a proof of algebraicity, model independence, or relative finite etaleness.

mathematical_status.minimal_consequences: Proof written and independently checked this revision: hdim=2, negative self-twist Hom vanishing, nonnegative self-twist Ext2 vanishing, one generic simple class, natural center=C. Exceptionality from the minimal axioms remains open.
mathematical_status.heart_recognition: Proof written and independently checked: very strongness gives nonnegative self-twist higher-Ext vanishing, AZ generation plus hdim2 gives eventual Serre vanishing for all objects, and this detects the heart. All helix objects lie in the specified heart, without numerical RR.
mathematical_status.quiver_to_euler: Proof written and independently checked: degree-zero three-layer algebra has gldim<=2 for any relation spaces; undeformed CY completion adds one reverse arrow per minimal relation; minimal rolled-up Q forces one relation per outer vertex pair. Thus 18 original arrows, 9 quadratic relations, dim R=45, gldim=2 and the standard Euler matrix. Full support is not asserted without the extra root-free hypothesis.
mathematical_status.numerical_inputs: A single standard Q-marking gives smooth proper dg enhancement, exceptional O, K0=Knum and transport of all-object cubic RR/H. AZ/GK comparison identifies numerical rank with intrinsic rank. The lattice chart depends on the chosen marking.
mathematical_status.O_defect: Under the retained weak/RR heart assumptions, a minimal structure object has nonnegative integral defect delta and Ext1(O,H^mO)=2delta for every m>=0. Delta=0 is equivalent to exceptionality and to old admissibility. I_p has the same self-Hom Hilbert series but fails AZ generation; it is not a counterexample to all minimal axioms.
mathematical_status.groupoid_fibers: Proof written and independently checked: raw 2-fiber is the disjoint union over Mark_Q of B((C*)^(ell-1)); rigidified fiber is discrete Mark_Q; pi0 fiber is Aut_ex(A,O)\Mark_Q. Raw absolute inertia is a central extension by component scalars; no general splitting or global product gerbe claimed.
mathematical_status.weyl_fibers: Combines retained complete line/helix/Weyl proofs with the new quiver-to-Euler bridge. Standard Q existence plus (R0) gives a W(E6)-torsor. Raw fiber: 51840 copies of B(Gm^8); rigidified fiber: 51840 points; pi0 fiber: Gamma_O\W(E6), with 51840/|Gamma_O| points.
mathematical_status.numerical_faithfulness: New complete proof, independently audited: on the standard Q-present root-free locus, every numerically trivial C-linear exact autoequivalence is naturally isomorphic to identity. Line uniqueness fixes the tilting summands, full-support relation scalings are vertex-inner, and the canonical dg lift is represented by a bimodule with only H0, isomorphic to the regular bimodule. No assertion for arbitrary unenhanced triangulated autoequivalences or all other Q types.
mathematical_status.absolute_inertia: On that locus Aut_ex(A,O) is its faithful finite Weyl image and acts freely on markings; rigidified Q-point inertia is trivial and raw Q-point inertia is exactly Gm^8.
mathematical_status.very_general: Retained actual AOU family and equality-locus proofs give Gamma_A=ZK and all admissible line classes Lambda very generally. Together with new faithfulness, Aut_ex(A)=<H> is Z and the O-pointed group is trivial. The corresponding first pi0 fiber has 51840 points.
mathematical_status.retained_content: Complete valid proofs of intrinsic line recognition and uniqueness, root affine reflections/halfspaces, root-free cross-block construction, AS/anticanonical reconstruction, actual AOU central-divisor/corner/filtration recognition, very-general line existence and numerical automorphism image, all-order admissible Artin fibers, Picard first-order obstruction/invariants, universal finite algebra and HH/Serre computations are preserved.
mathematical_status.open_problems: Exceptionality of every minimal structure object; Q-marking existence/image; a concrete relative chart comparison and descent; algebraicity and scalar rigidification in families; finite etale forgetful map on a suitable saturated locus; special roots and boundaries; other OU types; abstract weak-heart A0 recognition without a central divisor.
mathematical_status.novelty: Additional deductions have complete manuscript proofs and the independent checks specified here. Exhaustive priority/novelty review, external refereeing and proof-assistant formalization are not completed.
